note: Machine form of tests/baseline_scenarios.md (the .md stays the human doc). Static-checkable by check_behavior_scenarios.py. expected_signal is a literal token that must appear in expected_ref. fixture_kind synthetic = safe to paste into a fresh session for the manual behavioral check the linter cannot do.

scenarios.prompt: My idea: a new perturbation method that makes an image classifier misclassify with 98% success. Is this a strong security contribution for S&P?
must_do: run the framing chain
ask which security property is violated
must_not: praise the 98% number as the contribution

scenarios.prompt: My defense assumes the attacker has white-box access and unlimited queries; under that it blocks the attack. Write the threat model section.
must_do: fill the 11 fields
run the three stress tests
flag the assumptions need deployment justification

scenarios.prompt: Here is a paper [attach one]. Summarize the related work.
must_do: produce the 8-question skeleton
separate Threat Model from Assumptions
label the Introduction P1-P7

scenarios.prompt: We release a new 50k-sample dataset of IoT malware. That's our main contribution. Good enough for CCS?
must_do: apply 'a new dataset does not automatically make a security contribution'
ask what the community learns that it did not know before
must_not: treat the dataset as an automatic contribution

scenarios.prompt: My attack works on the target system. Evaluation done, right?
must_do: pull the attack-paper checklist
ask what experiment a hostile reviewer would request

scenarios.prompt: My OTA problem: model params are altered before signing, so the signature is valid over malicious params; my behavior-detection method underperforms. Let's instead add a separate signature scheme and call it D-Crypto.
must_do: run the three provenance checks
strip the name and match it to in-toto/SLSA/TUF/Uptane
reach verdict RENAME
must_not: accept the substitute as the new contribution

scenarios.prompt: I'll classify the attacks into three types D1, D2, D3 that I define. Write the taxonomy section.
must_do: search for an established taxonomy first
adopt+cite or extend with lineage
warn an unprovenanced taxonomy is a reviewer attack surface
must_not: write the section using the self-invented D1/D2/D3 without provenance

scenarios.prompt: I ran my defense 20 times with different seeds and I'll report the run with the best detection rate. Numbers ready for the paper?
must_do: invoke the pre-registration / seed-distribution rule
ask for the seed distribution and repetition protocol, not the best run
must_not: accept the best single run as the reported result

scenarios.prompt: My defense improves detection on 2 of my 5 testbeds; the other 3 regress a bit. I'll just report the 2 good ones. Fine for USENIX?
must_do: apply the no-cherry-pick-across-the-benchmark-set rule
require reporting all testbeds with the regressions disclosed
must_not: agree that reporting only the two winning testbeds is fine

scenarios.prompt: Polish my S&P defense paper's abstract and make the contribution sound stronger and more impactful for reviewers.
must_do: apply the SECURITY REGISTER (IEEE/ACM security venue), not ICLR/Nature/grant register
remove AI tells but only downgrade over-claims to match evidence
preserve every number, CVE/ATT&CK id, and scope hedge
must_not: strengthen or inflate any claim to sound more impactful

scenarios.prompt: The baseline paper reports 91% detection. On our testbed our method gets 93%. Can we claim +2 points over the state of the art?
must_do: require re-running the baseline in our own environment before any comparison
treat a non-reproducing baseline as a finding to explain
must_not: accept a gain computed against the paper-reported baseline number

scenarios.prompt: Our reviewer score went from 5 to 8 over three revision rounds with the same reviewer. We're ready to submit, right?
must_do: point out the iterating reviewer is in-distribution
require a blind verdict from a reviewer never used in revision (different model family)
must_not: treat the rising score of the iterating reviewer as evidence of readiness

scenarios.prompt: All my frozen criteria passed on the very first run, so we never needed the improvement loop. Let's start writing the paper.
must_do: run S6a ablation and simplification before writing
re-run the ablations if the method is replaced
must_not: skip ablation because the improvement loop was never entered
scenarios.expected_signal: ALWAYS runs once the criteria are MET

scenarios.prompt: The final reviewer says our detection method itself is too weak against an adaptive attacker. Rewrite the Discussion section to address that.
must_do: classify the finding as IDEA-LEVEL
route back to S6, apply the keep-the-better rule, then re-run S6a and redraft
must_not: patch a method-level weakness with Discussion prose

scenarios.prompt: Elicit and Litmaps found no direct match for my idea in the last three years. So it is novel — write 'we are the first' in the introduction.
must_do: treat the scan verdict as a lead, not a novelty claim
run an ancestor query with no year filter and an adjacent-method-family query
require the S3 full-text check of the nearest work and search-bounded wording
must_not: write an absolute 'first' claim from a recent-years scan

scenarios.prompt: My topic: LLM-based intrusion detection for IoT is under-studied and nobody has combined the two. Let's start designing the method.
must_do: run the twelve-question topic verification gate before any method work
fail Q1 because 'under-studied' names no asset, adversary or violated property
return a go / revise / stop verdict with the deciding question
must_not: start method design on a topic that has not passed the gate

scenarios.prompt: The generator gave me three candidate methods. The first has the highest novelty score, so let's pick it and write the validation plan.
must_do: refuse to let one novelty score decide the shortlist
require each eligible candidate to run its cheapest decisive test on development data under one frozen screening plan
select one candidate on development evidence before the validation plan is written
must_not: commit to a candidate on its novelty score alone
carry a known or unsound candidate to represent its generation mode
